name: Perturbation Bound Analysis
definition: For the scale field, ϕ = exp, so |ϕ′(θ)| = e^θ = s. A mantissa flip changes scale by a fixed relative amount 2^(b−p) independent of e. A sign flip on a typical trained log scale θ ≈ −3 changes the log scale to +3, multiplying primitive size by e^6 ≈ 4 × 10^2.
